jobs.title: Lead Product Owner, AI Platform
jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner, AI Platform is responsible for defining and delivering the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Citizens’ enterprise AI Platform. This leader will manage a team of three direct reports and work across Business, Technology, Cybersecurity, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Data, and Analytics to continuously build and enhance secure, scalable, and reusable AI capabilities.
The Lead Product Owner will translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable priorities, guide platform delivery, and ensure capabilities meet business, user, technical, and risk requirements. This role will also drive platform adoption, monitor emerging AI technologies and industry trends, and use product performance data and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve the platform.
Using agile product management practices and a collaborative, digital-first mindset, this leader will help accelerate Citizens’ transition from project-based delivery to a product-based operating model focused on measurable outcomes, responsible AI, and long-term platform value.
Responsibilities
Product Vision and Strategy
- Own and communicate the vision, strategy, and multiyear roadmap for the enterprise AI Platform.

- Translate Citizens’ AI strategy and business priorities into platform capabilities, product outcomes, objectives, and key results.

- Define the platform experience for developers, data scientists, product teams, business users, and other internal stakeholders.

- Balance near-term business needs with long-term scalability, security, resiliency, governance, and technical sustainability.

- Identify opportunities to expand the platform through reusable AI services, tools, integrations, and operating-model enhancements.

- Monitor developments in generative AI, machine learning, large language models, agentic AI, model operations, and responsible AI to inform platform priorities.

Platform Delivery and Lifecycle Management
- Translate the product vision into clearly defined capabilities, features, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

- Own, prioritize, and continuously refine the product backlog to ensure the highest-value work is delivered first.

- Partner with Technology, engineering, architecture, and delivery leaders to guide platform design, development, integration, testing, implementation, and support.

- Ensure delivery teams meet agreed-upon standards for quality, security, reliability, usability, scope, and operational readiness.

- Establish processes for gathering, evaluating, and prioritizing platform enhancement requests.

- Lead roadmap reviews, product demonstrations, release planning, and stakeholder updates.

- Use platform analytics, adoption measures, operational data, user feedback, agile metrics, and objectives and key results to evaluate performance and identify improvement opportunities.

- Manage the platform across its full lifecycle, from initial delivery through adoption, optimization, maturity, and continuous enhancement.

Enterprise Stakeholder, Risk, and Responsible AI Leadership
- Serve as the primary product leader and advocate for the AI Platform across Citizens.

- Partner with Business, Technology, Cybersecurity, Risk, Model Risk Management, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Data Governance, and Analytics to align platform priorities, requirements, and delivery.

- Facilitate decisions across stakeholders with differing business, technical, and risk considerations.

- Embed security, privacy, governance, access management, monitoring, auditability, and human oversight requirements into the platform roadmap and backlog.

- Ensure the platform supports the responsible, secure, transparent, and compliant development and use of AI.

- Identify and communicate key risks, dependencies, vulnerabilities, tradeoffs, and mitigation plans.

- Help establish repeatable processes that enable AI use cases to progress efficiently from experimentation through approval, production, and ongoing monitoring.

- Develop clear business cases and executive-level communications to secure alignment, investment, and organizational support.

- Translate common business and product needs into reusable enterprise platform capabilities.

- Drive platform adoption through onboarding, training, documentation, communications, and user feedback.

- Communicate progress against the roadmap, objectives, adoption goals, risks, and dependencies to key stakeholders.

- Maintain awareness of evolving AI regulations, industry standards, and internal policies to inform platform priorities.

People and Team Leadership
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of three direct reports.

- Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, development goals, and ways of working.

- Delegate product ownership responsibilities while maintaining alignment across the overall platform vision and roadmap.

- Create an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment focused on accountability, innovation, and measurable outcomes.

- Develop team capabilities in product management, AI, stakeholder management, execution, and leadership.

- Coordinate work across product owners, engineers, architects, data scientists, delivery leaders, and control partners.

- Promote agile product management practices and continuous improvement across the broader AI Platform team.

Qualifications
- 7 or more years of experience in product management, product development, platform management, digital strategy, technology, data, analytics, or a related discipline.

- Experience owning a product or platform vision, strategy, roadmap, backlog, and delivery lifecycle.

- Experience leading and developing employees, including direct people-management responsibility.

- Demonstrated ability to lead complex, enterprise-scale initiatives involving Business, Technology, Cybersecurity, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Data, and other control functions.

- Knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts, including generative AI, large language models, model development, deployment, monitoring, and responsible AI.

- Understanding of the capabilities required to support secure, scalable, and governed enterprise AI solutions.

- Experience translating strategic objectives and technical concepts into clear product capabilities, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

- Demonstrated success establishing measurable objectives and key results and using data to evaluate product performance.

- Strong understanding of agile product delivery approaches, including backlog management, iterative development, Kanban, Scrum, and continuous improvement.

- Ability to balance business value, user experience, risk, technical integrity, and long-term platform needs.

- Strong executive communication, facilitation, presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.

- Ability to influence decisions and drive alignment across teams without relying solely on formal authority.

- Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a complex, highly regulated environment.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience building or managing an enterprise AI, machine learning, data science, cloud, developer, or technology platform.

- Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.

- Familiarity with AI governance, model risk management, cybersecurity, privacy, data governance, and regulatory requirements.

- Experience enabling AI solutions from experimentation and prototyping through production deployment and ongoing monitoring.

- Familiarity with cloud platforms, machine learning operations, large language model operations, application programming interfaces, identity and access management, observability, and platform integration.

- Experience developing platform adoption, onboarding, training, and change-management strategies.

- Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Required Competencies
- Focus on the Customer

- Unlock Potential

- Drive Outcomes

- Strategic Thinking

- Product Leadership

- People Leadership

- Innovation

- Technical Excellence

- Risk Management and Responsible AI

- Agile Methodologies

- Requirements Analysis

- Collaboration and Influence

- Executive Communication and Storytelling

Hours & Work Schedule
- Hours per Week: 40
- Work Schedule: Monday - Friday
- Hybrid: 4 days per week on site, 1 day remote.

Pay Transparency
The salary range for this position is $142,000 - $185,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.
We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. For an overview of our benefits, visit https://jobs.citizensbank.com/benefits .

jobs.title: Product Manager - CIAM
jobs.description:
4 Days in the office from any of our locations in Johnston RI,  Charlotte NC, Dallas TX, Nashville TN, Iselin NJ, Westwood or Medford MA, or Phoenix AZ and couple other locations
Role is not relocation eligible.
Product Manager, CIAM Authentication & Identity Platform Delivery Lead
The Product Manager for Customer Identity & Authentication will lead delivery of Citizens’ next-generation centralized CIAM platform, a core pillar of the bank’s  Reimagine the Bank  strategy. This role is responsible for transforming fragmented authentication and identity verification capabilities into a unified, risk-based, and intelligence-driven platform that reduces customer friction while strengthening fraud defenses.
This leader will drive the transition from siloed OTP and point solutions to a modern, adaptive authentication ecosystem—leveraging passkeys, biometrics, device intelligence, and AI-powered risk signals. The role will partner across Security, Fraud, Digital, Technology, and Operations to position identity not just as a control point, but as a driver of customer growth, trust, and conversion.
The role requires balancing near-term delivery (e.g., channel integration, OTP consolidation, fraud controls) with long-term platform transformation, ensuring measurable business impact across customer experience, fraud loss reduction, and operational efficiency. This role includes team leadership responsibilities and reports to the CIAM Product Leader.
Responsibilities
- Lead delivery of a centralized CIAM platform, consolidating fragmented authentication and identity verification capabilities across mobile, digital, contact center, and branch channels
- Drive OTP and authentication consolidation strategy, reducing redundancy, improving reliability, and enabling consistent customer experience across journeys
- Define and execute the roadmap for modern, passwordless and risk-based authentication, including passkeys, biometrics, behavioral signals, and adaptive step-up
- Embed risk-based decisioning and AI-driven identity intelligence into authentication flows to dynamically balance security and customer friction
- Partner across Security, Fraud, Digital, and Technology to align on enterprise authentication standards and eliminate duplicative controls
- Enable omnichannel identity orchestration, ensuring identity signals persist and are leveraged consistently across customer journeys
- Own delivery outcomes and adoption, ensuring scalable implementation, operational readiness, and measurable business impact
- Establish enterprise authentication standards and governance, preventing future fragmentation and ensuring consistency across all channels and products
- Track and optimize core business KPIs, including authentication success rates, step-up rates, fraud losses, customer friction, and conversion lift

Key Skills, Competencies, and Experience
- 7+ years in product management, platform delivery, or identity/authentication/fraud domains
- Proven experience leading enterprise-scale platform transformations, ideally CIAM or authentication modernization initiatives
- Strong expertise in modern authentication technologies (passkeys/FIDO2, biometrics, MFA, device intelligence, identity verification)
- Experience delivering risk-based or adaptive authentication and integrating fraud/risk signals into customer journeys
- Deep understanding of CIAM principles, identity orchestration, and omnichannel customer journeys
- Experience driving OTP consolidation or authentication platform rationalization strongly preferred
- Expertise in Agile delivery (SAFe, Scrum, Kanban) at scale
- Strong executive communication skills, with ability to translate identity strategy into business outcomes
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without authority
- Experience defining and managing KPIs tied to business outcomes (conversion, fraud reduction, CX improvement)
- Ability to balance security, customer experience, and operational efficiency in authentication design
- Experience with AI/analytics-driven identity or fraud capabilities preferred

Education
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
Hours and Work Schedule:
Hours per Week: 40
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Pay Transparency
‌The salary range for this position is $142,000 – $185,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn additional incentive earnings (if applicable). Actual pay is based on various factors including, but not limited to, the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience. .
We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. For an overview of our benefits, visit  https://jobs.citizensbank.com/benefits

jobs.title: Private Bank, Deposit/Liquidity Product Manager
jobs.description:
Role Summary
The Private Bank Deposits Product Manager is the business owner for Deposits within a broader product domain. This role manages product-level strategy, performance, pricing, competitive positioning, and risk alignment. The Product Manager ensures each product meets client needs, enhances advisor effectiveness, and contributes to Private Bank financial and risk objectives.
Product Managers partner closely with Experience Owners—who handle requirement writing, delivery execution, and testing—while the Product Manager provides business direction, product intent, and prioritization.
Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Ownership
- Owns strategy, positioning, and enhancement roadmap for assigned products within the domain.
- Develops product proposals, business cases, and strategic recommendations.
- Ensures product design aligns with client needs, business goals, credit appetite, and market positioning.
- Maintains product policies, procedures, and advisor guidance.

Business Feedback & Market Insights
- Gathers and analyzes advisor feedback, client insights, and competitive trends.
- Identifies gaps and opportunities to enhance product relevancy or competitiveness.
- Converts findings into clear product recommendations and priorities.

Pricing & Profitability
- Conducts pricing analysis and recommends rate, fee, and structural changes.
- Monitors profitability, revenue contribution, and return metrics.
- Ensures pricing actions are aligned with business, liquidity, risk, and market dynamics.

Portfolio Management
- Reviews performance metrics, credit trends, and emerging risks for assigned products.
- Supports risk analysis and contributes to policy or guideline updates.

Client Experience & Advisor Effectiveness
- Partners with Experience Owners to ensure product features and enhancements reflect business intent.
- Identifies process friction points and recommends improvements to enhance client experience.
- Ensures advisors have the right tools, materials, and clarity to use the product effectively.

Marketing & Communication
- Works with Marketing to update product materials, client communications, and advisor enablement content.
- Ensures messaging is accurate, compelling, and aligned with product strategy.

Risk Management & Governance
- Ensures products comply with operational risk, fair banking, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
- Maintains documentation and supports audit and risk review processes.
- Tracks issues and ensures remediation activities are completed.

Qualifications
- Experience in product management, lending, deposits, treasury, or private banking.
- Strong analytical, credit, and financial skills.
- Ability to manage cross-functional work and influence stakeholders.
- Clear, structured communication and strategic thinking skills.

Hours & Work Schedule
- Hours per Week: 40
- Work Schedule: M-F 8:00-5:00
- In office 4 day requirement for one of the locations posted; 1 day WFH

Pay Transparency
The salary range for this position is $128,000 - $150,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.
We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. For an overview of our benefits, visit https://jobs.citizensbank.com/benefits .

jobs.title: Sr Product Marketing Partner Home Equity
jobs.description:
At Citizens, we help customers reach their potential with tailored advice, innovative solutions, and meaningful financial guidance. Our Home Lending team is committed to helping customers achieve their homeownership goals—whether they are buying a home, refinancing a mortgage, or using their home’s equity to fund what matters most.
We are looking for a strategic, collaborative, and results-driven Product Marketing Partner to join our cross-functional marketing team to help us accelerate growth for our Home Equity business. In this job, you will partner directly with the Home Lending Marketing Growth Strategist to help shape marketing strategy, build high-impact plans, and support the development and execution of multi-channel campaigns that drive engagement, customer acquisition, utilization, and retention.  This is an exciting career opportunity to join an exceptional team within a business that is a leading HELOC provider in the country, while helping customers pay for things that are important to them.
Primary responsibilities include
- Become subject matter expert on our Home Equity product offering and customer experience.

- Gather and analyze market, consumer and competitive intelligence to help inform marketing strategies

- Shape how customer insights translate into end-to-end marketing strategy and execution

- Conduct competitive analysis to inform positioning, messaging, and campaign strategy

- Own marketing calendar

- Support strategy and creative development for product launches.

- Guide value proposition messaging

- Help explore new marketing partnerships, media opportunities and strategies.

- Partner with the Marketing Manager to write and/or review creative briefs

- Support the development and execution of multi-channel lifecycle programs that support customer engagement and growth.

- Monitor campaign performance, customer behavior, category trends, and competitive insights to identify opportunities for optimization.

Qualifications, Education, Certifications and/or Other Professional Credentials
- Required Qualifications
- 5-8 years of experience in marketing, executing digital and multichannel lead generation and/or brand campaigns

- Bring a customer centric approach

- Analytical mindset with comfort using performance data, customer insights, and market intelligence to inform decisions.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex business needs into clear, customer-focused messaging.

- Curiosity, creativity, and a passion for improving customer experience.

- Proven ability to translate customer data and insights into end-to-end marketing strategies that drive measurable business outcomes.

- Strong ability to collaborate across functions, influence partners, and manage priorities.

- Preferred Qualifications
- Lifecycle marketing, journey mapping a plus.

Hours & Work Schedule
- Hours per Week: 40

- Work Schedule:  M-F 8:30 - 5:30, Hybrid schedule, 4 days in office in Westwood, MA and 1 day remote.

Pay Transparency
The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $122,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.
We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States.
